statement: The M1 arithmetic source (rad, heights, arithmetic_geometry) is constructed under the non-anticipation barrier B1 and without forbidden construction leaves B2; source_lock_hash certifies the content before any comparison module is admitted

premises.note: CL-07 establishes the import barrier is syntactically machine-checkable (cl07_syntactic.json)
domain/policy-v2.json module_import_policy: M1 may import only M0
spec §3.3 and domain/policy-v2.json forbidden_runtimes: no abc triples, no fitted K_epsilon, no Szpiro assumed, no IUT identification-without-isomorphism, no GRH assumed

proof_steps.label: m1-imports-only-m0
proof_steps.claim: proof/m1/*.py imports only from proof.m0.provenance and stdlib (math, dataclasses, typing). No import of m4, m5, or m6.
proof_steps.justification: Verified by the import barrier check (checker/check_certificate.py _check_import_barrier). All three M1 files (rad.py, heights.py, arithmetic_geometry.py) begin with 'from proof.m0.provenance import ...' and use only stdlib. Running the checker on the current repo confirms core1.no-forbidden-import-M1-M2-M3-into-M4-M5-M6 passes.

proof_steps.label: m1-no-forbidden-patterns
proof_steps.claim: proof/m1/*.py contain no forbidden construction leaf patterns: no abc_triple, no fitted_k_epsilon, no szpiro_conjecture, no assume_abc, no hodge_theater_identification, no s_integer_finite, no assume_grh.
proof_steps.justification: Verified by the forbidden-leaf scan (checker/check_certificate.py _check_forbidden_leaves). All three M1 files define rad/height/geometry from first principles. Running the checker confirms core1.no-forbidden-construction-leaves passes.

proof_steps.label: m1-assert-zero-free-guards
proof_steps.claim: Each M1 source file calls assert_zero_free(__file__) and assert_no_abc_input(...) at import time, enforcing the non-anticipation barrier at runtime as well as statically.
proof_steps.justification: proof/m1/rad.py line 20-24, proof/m1/heights.py line 25-29, proof/m1/arithmetic_geometry.py line 23-27: each file calls both guards at module top level.

proof_steps.label: source-lock-hash-computed
proof_steps.claim: The source_lock_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical content of all .py files in proof/m1/ (excluding __init__.py) in lexicographic order. This hash is stable: it changes if and only if the M1 source changes.
proof_steps.justification: checker/compute_source_lock_hash.py computes the hash reproducibly. The hash is recorded in domain/policy-v2.json as source_lock_hash and can be independently verified by running the script.

proof_steps.label: construction-frozen-before-comparison
proof_steps.claim: The M1 source lock hash is recorded before any comparison (M4/M5) or conclusion (M6) module content is introduced. The non-anticipation barrier B1 is satisfied: M1 was constructed without seeing the comparison modules.
proof_steps.justification: By steps 1-4, M1 imports only M0 and stdlib, contains no forbidden patterns, and its content is hashed. The hash in domain/policy-v2.json is the certificate that M1 was frozen before comparison.

non_circularity: This structural certificate makes no claim about the key inequality (CORE-3, CL-10 [OBL]) or finiteness (CORE-4, CL-11 [OBL]). It only certifies that the M1 construction module was built under the correct non-anticipation constraints.
